author: serafimcloud
name: halftone-vibe
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Halftone style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#0B1026, #3D46E8, #B18CFF, #FFD6E7). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
